comparison_limitations: This is a two-run comparison, not a controlled single-variable experiment: airflow differs AND so do final O2, CO2, CO, specimen, and frames shot. Observed differences cannot be attributed to airflow alone.
No continuous sensor time-series exists for either run — only before/after O2/CO2/CO values. Burn durations are not documented.
Video playback time is NOT sensor time for either run; the two videos are independent recordings with no documented cross-synchronization. The 'link playback' control aligns playback position only.
Temperature is not measured and must not be inferred from flame colour in either video.
Air-display flow has a slow (~1 min) response, so the 5 vs 2 cm/s values carry uncertainty.
